C1.worst_defect: The hero never says who the product is for in plain words: the 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0' badge and 'Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first' assume the visitor knows what a server plugin is and that a developer must install it, so a shop owner who searched 'Vendure point of sale' cannot tell whether this is something they can set up themselves.
C1.where: home/desktop/01 (badge above h1, line under the Live demo / Quick start buttons); home/phone/01

C2.worst_defect: Nowhere on the home page does it say who makes or maintains VendurePOS. The only hint is an unexplained third-party domain in the comparison table, 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie'. To a newcomer, an unnamed maker plus a domain on a different brand reads as something hidden (Connect a till explains ph.wcpos.com is self-hosted PostHog, but the home page does not).
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; home footer 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.'

C3.worst_defect: The quick start loads the main path with legacy-host noise: 'https://vendurepos.vercel.app serves the same build' in the first paragraph and 'A store that already allows https://vendurepos.vercel.app keeps it for as long as anyone still opens the POS at that address' in the CORS step. Neither helps a first install, and a newcomer wonders which URL to use. There is also no screenshot of the sign-in screen or of a synced order, so step 8 and 'Check it worked' are text only.
C3.where: quick-start/desktop/01 (intro paragraph), quick-start/desktop/02 (end of step 5), quick-start/desktop/03-04 (step 8, no [image:] marker in text/quick-start.txt)

C4.worst_defect: The Changelog is written in internal shorthand that only the authors can parse, for example 'order.create v5 custom lines are real order lines on a plugin-owned, disabled 'POS custom item' variant', '(ADR 0005)', 'Migration TallyPosV51790900000000'. Each version's 'In short' line helps, but the bullets do not say what changes for a store owner.

C5.worst_defect: Below the hero the home page is eight identical grey text-only cards, then a plain table, then a dense six-bullet 'Before you start' list. There are no icons and no second visual, so the page reads like a docs page. The hero screenshot also stops mid-row, showing the top edges of a cut-off fourth row of product tiles.
C5.where: home/desktop/01 bottom of the hero screenshot (y≈1140) and 'What it does today' cards; home/desktop/02 'Before you start'

C6.worst_defect: On phone the hero image is the till's cart view with its first column header truncated to 'Q...', and the image runs across two slices, so the Checkout button only appears after scrolling past the first screen. On the home page the top nav shows only a search icon and a chevron, so the Docs, Live demo and Quick start links are hidden.
C6.where: home/phone/01 (cart table header 'Q...  ITEM  TOTAL', top nav), home/phone/02 (Checkout €59.59 at top)

C7.worst_defect: Small: mobile LCP is 2.4 s on / and 2.5 s on /docs/quick-start (Lighthouse flags ~52 KiB unused JS and render-blocking requests). The 404 page logs a 'Failed to load resource: 404' console error. Titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, the search API and the share card are all present and correct.
C7.where: tech.json lighthouse '/' and '/docs/quick-start'; pages not-found.* consoleErrors

overall_worst.defect: A first-time visitor cannot find out who is behind VendurePOS. The home page names no maker, team or company, and the only outside name it shows is the unexplained analytics domain 'ph.wcpos.com' in the demo comparison row. Being asked to put an unknown-author pre-release till on your shop's server, with an unfamiliar third-party domain beside the demo, is what makes this persona hesitate.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 table row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline' and the footer; home/phone/04
overall_worst.fix: Add one line to the footer or near 'Before you start' saying who builds and maintains VendurePOS (for example 'Made by the team behind WCPOS'). In the demo row, write 'to our self-hosted PostHog analytics at ph.wcpos.com'.
